svg.title: Encrypted is not the same as safe
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Encrypted is not the same as safe” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch contrasting a properly authenticated TLS connection, drawn as a locked tube between client and server carrying confidentiality, integrity and authentication, with the same picture under verify=False where an attacker is spliced into the middle holding two perfectly good tunnels and the client's lock is crossed out in red; below it the chain of trust from root CA to intermediate to leaf with a self-signed certificate crossed out, a to-scale comparison of a 53 millisecond TLS 1.2 handshake against a 32.5 millisecond TLS 1.3 handshake and a zero-RTT stub marked replayable, and a reverse proxy box annotated with the three things it changes.
svg.text: Encrypted is not the same as safe
draw it from memory, then compare
